prompt: What is the session-to-application completion rate for the last 30 logical days?

results.text: Session-to-application completion is 65.0% over the last 30 logical days: 8,400 sessions started and 5,460 applications were submitted.

sql.command: SELECT SUM(sessions_started) AS sessions_started, SUM(applications_submitted) AS applications_submitted FROM aa_digital_funnel
